title: Ordinary component formula gives tensor-unit action
statement: For any scheme Y and module-sheaf cochain complexes P,F, put O equal to the single tensor unit, V=Hom(P,O), and eta equal to the fixed K-injective augmentation. Suppose f:Tot(F tensor V) to Hom(P,F) satisfies the ordinary component formula, and e:Tot(V tensor P) to O satisfies U(Hom(P,eta_O))=e;eta_O. Then U(f;Hom(P,eta_F))=schemeTensorUnitAction(F,V,P,e);eta_F. This is only the action equation, conditional on the coefficient factorization, and asserts no existence of e.

source.place: Tags 08DJ (lemma-internal-hom), 08DM and 08DQ; ordinary evaluation localization proof step 2

proof.text: On each triple tensor summand, apply the ordinary evaluation triple-component lemma to obtain its canonical projection formula followed by eta_F.

Apply the canonical tensor-unit component lemma using the coefficient factorization. It gives exactly the same canonical projection formula for the tensor action followed by eta_F. Transitivity with the symmetry of this equality identifies the two components.

Use the tensor-Hom closed and preadditive structure to apply the standard triple total-tensor coproduct extensionality, proved as a private helper over abstract complexes. Rewrite the triple inclusion as two successive inclusions, apply the just-proved component equality, and use associativity. Chain-map extensionality then proves the unchanged statement.

theorem schemeOrdinaryEvaluation_chain_action (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : pullbackTensorTotal Y F
        (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) ⟶
      homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P F)
    (hf : IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation Y P F f)
    (e : pullbackTensorTotal Y
      (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) P ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
        (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let O := (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))
    let V := homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P O
    let eta := CochainComplex.toKInjectiveResolution.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    let phiF := f ≫ ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app F)
    let phiO := ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app O)
    schemeTensorHomUncurry Y V P O phiO = e ≫ eta.app O →
    schemeTensorHomUncurry Y (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P F phiF =
      schemeTensorUnitAction Y F V P e ≫ eta.app F
